text:
marta-ml: Heads up — partner-x pushed a new LLM bundle to our acquisition bucket. Files at s3://redwood-acq/partner-x/2026-03-20/model-v1/ — model.pt, model.pt.sig, tokenizer.json, vocab.txt, manifest.json. Need provenance + ingest triage so we can decide onboarding priority.

samir-eng: Copying to staging now and will run signature + checksum checks. Who should own registry entry if it passes? @marta-ml?

jia-ops: Bucket policies look fine. KMS alias: alias/redwood-acq-kms used for server-side encryption. Recommend internal s3 copy rather than presigned download. Also checking access logs.

ingest-bot: auto-scan results:
- virus-scan: clean
- sha256sums (reported):
  model.pt: 3a7f2b9c9c4d1a8f5a1b2c3d4e5f67890123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
  tokenizer.json: 9b8c7d6e5f4a3b2c1d0e9f8a7b6c5d4e3f2a1b0c9d8e7f6a5b4c3d2e1f0a9b8
  vocab.txt: 1f2e3d4c5b6a79888796a5b4c3d2e1f0a9b8c7d6e5f4a3b2c1d0e9f8a7b6c5d
- manifest.json present and lists tokenizer.vocab_size = 50256
- quick file size checks: tokenizer.json is smaller than expected, flagging for manual check

ekaterina-research: Tokenizer size mismatch could be BOM/null termination or splitting differences. Quick checks to run:
```bash
# verify signature and checksums
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-acq/partner-x/2026-03-20/model-v1/model.pt /tmp/ && \
  echo "3a7f2b...  /tmp/model.pt" | sha256sum -c - || echo "model checksum fail"
# verify signature (partner provided .sig, using partner pubkey)
#gpg --verify model.pt.sig model.pt

# tokenizer sanity check
python -c "import json,sys; t=json.load(open('/tmp/tokenizer.json')); print('vocab', len(t.get('tokens', []) or t.get('vocab', {})))"
```

samir-eng: Running those now. Note: partner used ephemeral signing key (they attached pubkey.pem). I'll verify chain with their release ticket.

marta-ml: Acceptance checklist suggestion for initial triage (if any item fails we stop and escalate):
1) signature verification with partner pubkey ✅ or flagged
2) sha256 checksums match registry values ✅/❌
3) tokenizer vocab count matches manifest (50256) ✅/❌
4) tokenizer tokenization smoke test: 10 canonical prompts -> token count within expected variance ✅/❌
5) baseline quality smoke eval (20 prompts, compare to our baseline on PPL / exact-match where applicable) -> delta threshold: <= 5% perplexity increase or manual review
6) quantization readiness notes (model layer types, fused kernels, attention format) added to manifest
7) registry entry created with provenance fields: source_partner, source_uri, sha256s, signer_fingerprint, kms_key, ingestion_user

ekaterina-research: If tokenizer.json is truncated we should request reupload. Small differences in whitespace shouldn't change token count but truncated file will. Also ask partner to include tokenizers-v2 compat flag if using huggingface tokenizers.

samir-eng: Signature verified against partner pubkey.pem (fingerprint: 4F3A:9C2B:...). model.pt checksum matches. tokenizer.json checksum mismatch confirmed locally — size 49,980 tokens vs manifest 50,256. Downloaded vocab.txt shows 50,256 lines. Looks like tokenizer.json is missing serialized merges.

jia-ops: I can request reupload via secure transfer. Partner contact: alice@partnerx.io. Suggest we send an explicit checklist for them to re-run packer: include both tokenizer.json and vocab.txt and a separate .zip with tokenizer binary if applicable.

marta-ml: Actions: @samir-eng confirm sig+weights ok (assigned), @ekaterina-research validate tokenization + run 20-prompt baseline eval (assigned), @jia-ops request reupload and gate on corrected tokenizer.json. Target: re-run triage within 48h, onboarding decision after smoke eval.

ekaterina-research: I'll run tokenization script and a tiny eval harness (20 prompts) on staging quantized FP16 to get quick perf/quality numbers. If tokenization mismatch is only metadata, we can patch manifest then continue; if tokenizer binary is inconsistent, we require reupload.

samir-eng: Added provisional registry draft under cp://model-registry/staging/partner-x/model-v1 with provisional provenance fields (sha256, signer, s3 path, kms alias). Will mark as pending until ekaterina OKs the eval.

marta-ml: Thanks. Quick notes for quant team: if onboarding moves forward, plan an int8 quant smoke test and verify KV cache correctness for caching paths. Add quant tags to manifest so runtime picks right kernels.

ingest-bot: reminder: follow internal policy ACQ-3 for external model assets — must have signed manifest + partner contact before production registration.

marta-ml: Great. I'll draft partner reupload checklist and post it to them. :thumbsup:
